annotation.evidence_span: Within a SVCB RRSet, all RRs SHOULD have the same Mode.
annotation.interpretation_a: The clause is taken to mean that every RR in an SVCB RRSet must use the same Mode, so an RRSet cannot contain both AliasMode and ServiceMode records.
annotation.interpretation_b: The clause is interpreted as a recommendation that RRs should share the same Mode, but the following clause allows an RRSet to contain both AliasMode and ServiceMode records, effectively overriding the recommendation.
annotation.justification: The target clause conflicts with the next clause, which explicitly permits an RRSet to contain records in both AliasMode and ServiceMode. This indirect inconsistency creates two materially different implementation interpretations.
